content: Confirmed via jsdom project docs and happy-dom GitHub issues (cross-checked, two independent sources): neither jsdom nor happy-dom implement a real layout engine; getBoundingClientRect/offsetWidth/offsetTop always return zero. Any pixel-position/visual-alignment assertion is untestable under Vitest+happy-dom and must be deferred to manual/browser-based verification (e.g. Playwright) or accepted as human-verify.
